limits: Native entrance was observed after replacing only this theme in the existing app; no application exit/restart was performed.
Native replay measurements cover one manual replay before and after the change, without changing real conversations.
Chrome fixture navigation uses synthetic conversation markers and controlled callbacks; it is not a native navigation latency benchmark.
The automatic native entrance observation included 124ms and 87ms long tasks during initial runtime and shader preparation; warmed manual replay observed none.
Earlier injection removes the complete-app-shell wait. An external launcher still connects after the native renderer exists, so zero native-theme flash is not promised.
